A.claim: Level lowering in the style of Azon arXiv:2504.01967v2 Theorem 5.23 applies to the weighted equation X^10 + 256 Y^10 = Z^17 and eliminates the surviving Frey representation.

B.claim: rank_Z J^-(L) < 8 where L is the degree-10 extension of k = Q(sqrt5) generated by a root of x^10 + 256, so that Chabauty-Coleman applies to C^-(L) - the field that actually contains the points coming from solutions of X^10 + 256 Y^10 = Z^17.
